title: DocOps SPEC registry
description: Optional .docops-policy.json at a repository root, read from the inspected snapshot. Registers which SPEC files are tracks. Whether a SPEC is active or idle is declared inside the SPEC itself, as `spec-state: idle` in its frontmatter (ADR-0013 Decision 1), not here. Without this file, a root-level SPEC.md is the single implicit track 'root'. See ADR-0013.

specs.description: Registered SPEC tracks. A registered path that is absent from the snapshot is a FAIL. An empty list registers no tracks; any SPEC.md then present is reported out of scope.

path.description: Relative POSIX path from the repository root; no '..', '.', empty or '.git' components, no backslashes. Must be unique.

track.description: Track name, unique within the policy.
